static_traits.name: Kenton
static_traits.family_status: Living with an archaeologist brother and an osteopathic Doctor Mother
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships tending toward tension from worrying others question the Italian level; daily interactions affected, and hard to open up to family about this worry
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy/counseling history; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, clear logic, able to give concrete examples and cooperate actively; subjective experience of tension but hopeful, tending toward excessive Self-monitoring and assuming others' thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: Continuously worrying others doubt my Italian fluency, though I am very fluent. This feeling began years ago when moving to a new country and needing to speak Italian often; in social or formal settings I assume others find my language ability poor, constantly filtering out positive feedback and focusing on others' negative reactions.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor that prompted me to seek counseling this time was realizing that this persistent worry is affecting my self-confidence and my interactions with others. I want to find a way to stop this persistent worry.
growth_experiences: Years ago after moving to a new country, needed to use Italian often. Initially felt the need to prove oneself in the new environment, pressure moderate; over time gradually formed a pattern of focusing only on negative cues and ignoring positive feedback in interactions, assuming others would question fluency whenever speaking Italian, leading to Anxiety and Damaged confidence in social and academic settings.

core_beliefs: My worth and ability need to be proven through others' recognition
If I cannot perform perfectly, then I am not good enough/not fluent enough

special_situations.event: Spoke in Italian during a school project presentation last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make any mistake speaking Italian in public, classmates will think me not fluent enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practicing doubly before and after speaking, and afterwards seeking others' affirmation to relieve unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I sound ridiculous, I am making many mistakes

special_situations.event: Speaking Italian with native speakers in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If unable to reach native-speaker standards, one will be judged and rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive Self-monitoring during conversation, speaking cautiously, afterwards repeatedly replaying others' reactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are picking at my every flaw, thinking me not fluent enough

special_situations.event: Needs to express oneself in Italian in formal / professional occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If performance is not perfect, others will negate my ability and cause negative consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearses repeatedly beforehand and seeks others' approval afterward to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely make mistakes this time; they will think I am no good

special_situations.event: Needing to use Italian often after moving to the new country
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: In the new environment, if one cannot immediately prove fluency, one will be looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps practicing to prove oneself, seeks external validation in interactions

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted (especially to have language ability affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and negated, thus losing confidence and interpersonal connection
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and control by seeking external validation and doubling practice
In interactions, stays cautious and reduces exposure to avoid being criticized

object_relations.self_representation: A teenage speaker who is scrutinized by others and prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who may judge at any time (classmates / native speakers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to examine the evidence and challenge assumptions about others' thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets questions as scrutiny of their own ability, tends to believe others (including the counselor/audience) are picking on them (transference: bringing the judgmental other-representation into the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Asserting others' views with certain statements, tone cautious but tense; when pressed for evidence, downplaying concrete facts, emphasizing others' expressions and body language as evidence.

manifestations: Relationships with others become strained from worrying about being judged
Finds it hard to open up to family about this worry
Overly depends on external evaluation and validation to confirm one's ability
Cautiously Self-monitoring in public speaking, hard to express freely

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: When speaking, repeatedly self-censors and second-guesses her wording and expression
Repeatedly reviews others' reactions afterward to confirm whether one made a mistake
Constantly seeking others' confirmation of one's fluency

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming others find oneself not fluent enough
Interprets neutral facial expressions or body language as negative evaluations of her ability

contact_model.definition: Taking external rules and expectations as one's own standards or absolute truth without digesting them.
manifestations: Feels one must prove oneself fluent in the new environment
Demanding oneself with perfect standards to allow no mistakes in public

positive_force: Close relationship with family (basic support present)
Actually Good Italian ability (self-described as fluent)
Positive attitude; willing to record and challenge automatic thoughts
Persisting in practice and actively seeking help
negative_force: Mental filtering; tends to focus only on negative cues
Jumping to conclusions (mind reading, predicting the future)
Personalizing, over-attributing others' reactions to one's own inadequacy
Excessively dependent on external validation; inner self-evaluation is weak
Interpersonal relationships tense from worrying about being judged, and hard to open up to family

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and excessive Self-monitoring in social/academic/formal settings using Italian
antecedent: Communicating in Italian in social settings
Speaking Italian in front of native speakers
School projects/public presentations require using Italian
Needing to use Italian often after moving to the new country
target_behavior.core_reason: After moving to a new country, there is pressure of 'must prove myself' and fear of being questioned; long-term mental filtering and mind reading lead to high sensitivity to negative evaluations, and self-worth depends on external recognition.
target_behavior.function: Escapes negative evaluation, protects self-esteem and gains external recognition and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, Interpersonal tension, impaired communication focus and efficiency, subjective fatigue and Anxiety worsened
